core_blocked_full_F_parameters.changing_these_for_full_F: SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED; never delete guards to pretend parameter sweep

phase0.arms: one S reference per Ns, one F reference per Nf; WV_ZERO_RO explicit separate stratum for missing RO
phase0.new_start_ceiling_formula: Ns + Nf + Nwv (reuse only exact complete Source/input/hardware/observer acceptance; no automatic old-budget inheritance)

phase1.scope: Predeclare a diverse small exploration set E from baseline behavior, not from speedup; include compute, streaming, dirty/copy, Tag-pressure, response-queue, multi-kernel, and a held-out group. This is not final workload coverage.
phase1.single_factor_rule: same costed hardware delta in S/F; retain every slowdown/failure/missing arm

phase2.composition: Merge structured config fields, not conflicting whole-string overrides; record actual282. Missing benefit alone does not suppress these combinations.
phase2.scope: Same E plus a predeclared held-out subset, finite up to6 causal combinations even if no singleton wins

phase3.ranking: Full common-set GM, slowdown count/worst slowdown, coverage and cost Pareto; no per-input best cherry-picking as deployable global policy.
phase3.scope: Up to3 globally fixed candidates selected on common exploration set then validated over ALL common eligible ordinary inputs

review_boundary.not_authorization: No model starts, dispatch registrations, retries or new budget created by this proposal. Main freezes exact finite stage specs and authorized counts.
review_boundary.stop_or_expand: At finite phase boundary review evidence. If no benefit, document finite negative range and review source-blocked P/U/N directions or qualification/input repair; do not claim global impossibility and do not launch an unbounded sweep.

finite_search_design.universe: All eligible ordinary inputs, no8/12 workload cap. Ns all S-qualified; Nf subset exact F-qualified. UNRESOLVED remain an explicit repair queue; aliases dedup only by complete content identity proof.

D.separate_axes: Latency and frequency are separate conditions; never combine them then call one-key latency. Buswidth/burst alter atom/coalescing; defer until an explicit source/protocol/byte-unit audit.

G.extra_candidates_status: No application/native qualification; observer supported_geometry requires32/64 and8/16. No silent parser normalization.
G.hash_source: hashing.cc:9-97 supports exactly16/32/64 for P/IPOLY; unsupported values assert

N.diagnostic_boundary: DATA_FREE removes bank contention and is an optimistic diagnostic, not a hardware implementation or full bandwidth proof; needs CPU/NI qualification.
dormant_or_misleading: icnt_flit_size is not serialization bandwidth in local network_mode2
icnt_grant_cycles1 already minimizes hold;0 not a valid speed point

P.forbidden_fairness: Never weaken S to1160 physical lines (wbuf8) while leaving F1168. Full F WBUF8 violates guard.

U.hardware_cost: Queue entries, not mm2; FRFCFS/return also alter credit pool.
U.zero_values: Do not use zero as unlimited: FRFCFS add_req asserts pending<0; return0 allocates1024 but credit0 becomes unlimited.

reference_pair_warning: S example is Conv; F example is Vector. They are configuration templates, never a performance pair. Input/RO bindings must be per-workload.
